g.text: This is the namespace symbol used to represent the project via code.
If a type library is generated, this is the type library name
If a type library is generated, this is the type library description.
You can include compiler variables here, such as ${Architecture},
This is used for the default title caption of MsgBox and InputBox, and also is the value returned from the App.Title property
This is accesible at runtime via the App.HelpFile property, and is used in the Forms runtime help system (F1 / WhatsThis)
This is the form that will be shown at startup, or 'Sub Main'.
If not specified, 'Sub Main' is the default for EXEs, '(none)' is the default for DLLs.
When set, the icon from this form will be imported into the ICON resources during build.
The icon will be imported as the #1 resource entry in
The OS typically uses this icon to represent the application.
